form.message: Project Fulcrum — required identity conflicts with strict residency. Microsoft documents that Entra ID Core Store uses two or more Azure regions per geographic location; selecting a tenant country does not constrain it to Sweden Central. EU residency is not a Sweden Central-only guarantee. The approved requirements require both Entra workforce/external Volunteer identity and Sweden Central-only residency for identity/global dependencies. How should the Requirements owner handle this conflict? Keeping the boundary leaves implementation blocked. A revision request is not an approved exception or final Gate 2 approval; it must return to 02-Requirements before Architecture can adopt a changed requirement.

residency_conflict_resolution.title: Project Fulcrum — resolve the Entra residency conflict
residency_conflict_resolution.description: Choose a route or give a custom response in this same field. If requesting a revision and the acceptable boundary is already known, describe it here without personal information or target identifiers. No legal/security waiver, Azure access, spending or deployment is authorized.
enumNames: Retain Sweden Central-only for every capability — keep implementation blocked
Request a Requirements-owner revision — determine an acceptable explicit boundary before continuing
